title: Ghost Hunters Murder Mystery Weekend
excerpt: Check in Friday and settle into a weekend filled with mystery, intrigue and a few unexpected encounters.
content:
Check in Friday and settle into a weekend filled with mystery, intrigue and a few unexpected encounters. Your getaway begins with a Marché-style Welcome Dinner, featuring an interactive dining experience that sets the scene for the mysterious events to come.

Saturday is when the investigation begins. After a breakfast buffet, spend the day exploring the property as strange happenings, hidden clues and interactive Ghost Hunters-themed activities unfold around you. Follow the evidence, uncover secrets and work together to piece together the mystery before joining us for a three-course dinner.

As the evening unfolds, the investigation reaches its thrilling conclusion with interactive entertainment, where the final clues are revealed and the mystery is finally solved.​​

Package includes:

  • Weekend accommodation

  • Friday night marché-style dinner

  • Saturday night 3-course dinner

  • Saturday & Sunday breakfast buffet 

  • Interactive murder mystery entertainment Friday and Saturday night

For full package and resort details, visit the website link in the details section of this page.
